we demonstrate electrochromic notch filters from printed monochiral carbon nanotubes with high optical density, high modulation depth, high speed, and high stability.

the development of a new class of electrochromic materials based on semiconducting carbon nanotubes.
the development of a new class of EC materials with a tunable notch filter effect.

aerosol-jet-printed SWNT films with high density can be used as EC materials for notch filters with a high degree of tunability.
